notes.title: 2024/5/12 Version update
notes.content:
· Updated the basement to remove water bodies that could cause bugs.
· Adjusted the game difficulty to reduce the monster health in Easy and Normal modes.

notes.title: 2023/8/12 New version update
notes.content: Fixed a bug that would cause items in the backpack to be lost.

notes.title: 2023/07/02 Update
notes.content: "Easy" Difficulty: Increases the ammo supply and reduces the overall difficulty of the game.

notes.title: Price will be adjusted to FREE
notes.content:
In order to allow more players to play this game, the price will be adjusted to [b]free [/b]at [b]0:00 on June 25, 2023[/b].
thanks everyone.

notes.title: 1.2.0 version update notes
notes.content:
· Optimized the performance of the game.
· Fixed known bugs.

notes.title: Update notes on February 26, 2023
notes.content:
· Added feedback when zombies are shot.
· Added investigation files related to the plot.

· Optimize the bullet loading experience.
· Optimized the frame rate of the prison office area.
